title: GABA-A function and binding
summary: Darigabat as a WWOX ex vivo comparator.

graph.evidence: Acute EEG response. Focal trial unconfirmed.
graph.inference: Binding and potentiation favor different subtypes.
graph.hypothesis: Native inhibition can rise with preserved recruitment.
graph.experiment: Match engagement. Measure reversal and inhibitory charge.

evidence: Photosensitivity suppression was 6/7 in each active period and 2/7 on placebo. The REALIZE primary differences were +1.42 and +0.11 response-ratio points. Both 90% intervals included zero.
inference: Human alpha2 construct binding was 16.2-fold weaker and maximum potentiation 6.3-fold higher than alpha1. Global PET occupancy cannot identify native subtype engagement.
hypothesis: A useful response increases absolute inhibitory charge, reduces later bursts and preserves first recruitment.
experiment: Compare darigabat with diazepam at matched site engagement and verified exposure. Measure native GABA reversal and test sensitivity to site blockade.
limits: Conditional ex vivo comparator. Juvenile exposure remains unknown. Dizziness occurred in 10/52 in the higher REALIZE arm and in 4/51 on placebo.
